badly.line: She must be hurt, very badly
stanza: She hangs her head, and cries in my shirt
She must be hurt, very badly
Tell me what’s making you sad, Li?
Open your door, don’t hide in the dark
You’re lost in the dark, you can trust me
’Cause you know that’s how it must be

madly.line: And the bantam is preening madly
stanza: And the bantam is preening madly
Waiting for the light of day
And all I want to do
Is to make love to you
With a careless mind
With a careless, careless mind
With a careless, careless mind
Who cares what's mine?
With a careless, careless, careless mind
Once I knew a girl
She was a flower in a flame
I loved her as the sea
Sings sadly
Now the ashes of the dream
Can be found in the magazines
And it seems that there are
No more songs
